blocks.text: John Arcilla and Xyriel Manabat lead the acting nominees for the 2026 CinePanalo Film Festival, as established stars and emerging performers vie for the festival’s top performance awards. Festival director Chris Cahilig announced the nominees during a livestream on the official CinePanalo Facebook page over the weekend ahead of the awards night on Sept. 30.
